t: Programmable digital clock thermostat for use with electric underfloor heating systems. Smart self-learning facility includes built-in setback mode with 7 day programming. Supplied with a 12kΩ floor sensor or can be used with built-in air sensor. Suitable for both Klima underfloor heating products and other compatible electric underfloor heating systems. Also features floor limiter for wooden floors and easy menu system. Technical support helpline available.
b: Suitable for Use in Any Room
